# forward_nqe_library_query (Resource)

Publish a query to the organization's NQE library. The query becomes visible in the library and can back an NQE intent check.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Library path, for example `/Demo/Security/Open Security Groups`. Parent directories are created as needed. Changing it replaces the query.
- `source_code` (String) NQE source. Updating it publishes a new commit.

### Optional

- `commit_title` (String) Title recorded on the library commit.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Mirrors `path`, which is the query's identity in the library.
- `intent` (String) Intent string Forward derives from the query.
- `query_id` (String) Identifier Forward assigns the published query, for use in an NQE check.
